newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria inflation prelim 43.8 pct Jan 1-25.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria inflation prelim 43.8 pct Jan 1-25.

text.p: Bulgaria's monthly consumer price inflation quickened to 43.8 percent between January 1-25 from 26.9 percent in December, National Statistics Institute (NSI) preliminary figures show.
"The sharp lev fall was the basic factor fuelling inflation last month because it boosted energy prices," an NSI official told Reuters.
The calculation was based on price data for the first 25 days of January and did not reflect the impact of the lev slump in the last week of the month, the official said.
The lev traded around 930 per dollar on January 24, down from 580 at the beginning of the month. It nosedived to around 2,000 on January 31.
Final month-on-month and year-on-year figures for January could be expected later this month.
